analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize existing codebase starting from the Discover baseline.
requirements_understanding: The primary goal is to modernize the codebase.
Focus on maintaining legacy behavior while improving code quality.
Ensure backward compatibility and define clear error handling.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Legacy code needs to be analyzed for modernization readiness.
Define functional and non-functional requirements based on existing capabilities.
Implement a testing strategy to ensure requirements are met.
clarifications_requested: What specific legacy systems or components are in scope for modernization?
Are there any specific performance benchmarks that need to be met post-modernization?

outputSnapshot.executive_summary: The project aims to modernize the existing codebase while preserving legacy behavior and ensuring backward compatibility.

functional_requirements.title: Legacy Code Analysis
functional_requirements.description: Analyze the existing codebase to identify components for modernization.

functional_requirements.title: Backward Compatibility Assurance

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: Ground BDD acceptance criteria in real legacy golden flows before Build planning.
blocking.default_recommendation: Regenerate BDD from validated golden flows, route evidence, and SQL touchpoints before Build starts.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Acceptance criteria will not validate real legacy behavior, creating parity and release risk.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
